evaluation.aggregation: Accuracy is computed per platform and severity; platforms are macro-averaged, then severities are arithmetic-mean averaged. Box/radial is the arithmetic mean of the independently evaluated box and radial summaries.
evaluation.jpeg_scope_note: Strict means unseen as an explicit synthetic augmentation. Source files may already be JPEG encoded.
evaluation.severity_scope_note: Blur strengths follow the legacy Table 9 parameterization but are applied after the checkpoint's resize/center-crop. Noise and JPEG severities are a new rebuttal protocol and are explicitly listed in corruptions.py.
